```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("tbl.gistm")
root <- here::here()
if (!exists("GistmTable", inherits = FALSE)) {
  GistmTable <- data.table(
    "Class" = c("Low", "Significant", "High", "Very High", "Extreme"),
    "PAR" = c("None", "1–10", "10–100", "100–1,000", ">1,000"),
    "Consequences" = c("No expected loss of life; minimal off‑site impacts.", "Minor but reportable off‑site impacts.",
    "Major localized impacts, potential for multiple fatalities.",
    "Substantial regional impacts, likely multiple fatalities.",
    "Catastrophic, long‑term, widespread impacts, >100 likely fatalities."
    ),
    "Operations and Active-Care Closure" = c("1/200", "1/1,000", "1/2,475", "1/5,000", "1/10,000"),
    "Passive-Care Post-Closure" = c("1/10,000", "1/10,000", "1/10,000", "1/10,000", "1/10,000")
  )
  GistmNotes <- c("PAR = Population at Risk (off‑site persons)", "Annual-exceedance criteria during operations and active closure. The Extreme 1/10,000 UHS and MCE define the reported design bounds.",
  "The 1/10,000 UHS and MCE define the reported passive-closure design bounds."
  )
}
```
